_schema: machine-readable asset facts for the DSH 'Voice input' Russian ASR provider; verified against the app's bundled sherpa-onnx-node 1.13.8 (darwin-arm64) by teammate asr-model-ru

runtime.layoutNote: The JS package resolves the native addon from a SIBLING directory ../sherpa-onnx-darwin-arm64/sherpa-onnx.node (flat node_modules layout, as shipped in the app bundle). No DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH is required in that layout; verified working with plain `require('sherpa-onnx-node')`.

tokens.script: russian subword (▁ sentencepiece style), includes punctuation and ITN support

vad.note: sha256 matches the value quoted in the task spec exactly; revision equals current repo main.

languageSupport.en: partial: transcribes English but with frequent spelling/casing errors ("Fridey", "Autornoon"); not production quality
languageSupport.codeMixRuEn: poor: English words are rendered phonetically in Cyrillic ("коуд ревью", "пол-реквеt")
languageSupport.emptyNoSpeech: returns empty string on silence (no hallucination); pure noise returns "."

autoLanguageNote: GigaAM nemo-ctc has NO language switch at all; the field is not sent to the model. Set autoLanguage to the empty string so the plugin can represent 'auto' uniformly with whisper. For the whisper fallback engine, sherpa-onnx accepts ONLY "" for auto-detect: "auto" and "Auto" abort the process (exit 134, 'Invalid language: auto') and CANNOT be caught from JS. Never forward the literal string "auto" to the native layer.

recommended.minSafeSamplesNote: decode() ABORTS the process (SIGABRT/134, 'Invalid input shape: {0}') for waveforms shorter than 160 samples (10 ms @16 kHz). Observed crash at 0, 1 and 16 samples; 160 samples is safe. Guard before creating a stream.

vad.note: With minSilenceDuration<=0.25 the VAD over-segments running dictation and clips word onsets ("Надиктуй"->"Диктуй", 15:30 split into 'Пятнадцать часов' + '30 минут'). At 0.5 with 0.4 s pre-padding / 0.2 s post-padding around segment boundaries, the same audio yields 2 correct segments with full words and correct 15:30 ITN.

accuracy.note: The single 'word error' is pure inverse-text-normalization formatting: expected 'в девять утра', recognized 'в 9:00 утра'. No lexical errors were observed on the 5 Russian clips.

measured.punctuationAndCasing: present: sentence capitalization, '.', ',', '?', '!', ':' and §-quotes are emitted; occasional imperfect punctuation (':'->'.', quotes added around a quoted clause). ITN converts spoken times to digits ('15:30', '9:00').

fp32Variant.reason: Not downloaded/tested: int8 is already accurate enough that remaining error is ITN formatting only (corpus WER 3.03%, 0 lexical errors), and int8 saves 566 MB of download and ~0.5 GB of RAM. fp32 is a drop-in same-config replacement if int8 ever regresses.

fallback.autoLanguageWarning: "auto" and "Auto" are FATAL in sherpa-onnx 1.13.8 (native abort, exit 134). Only "" means auto-detect.

accuracy.note: Lexical errors: 'Надиктуй'->'На диктую', 'напомни'->'напомним', truncated final word in clip4 ('до конца' missing 'недели'), 'Ханты-Мансийска'->'Ханты Мансиска'.

measured.autoDetect: language "" and "ru" produced byte-identical Russian transcripts on the test set.

downloads.note: All sizes verified byte-for-byte against the expected values in the task spec.
